operations.detail: Remote HEAD, same-owner lease, queue and absent revision11 attribution/evidence/web-acceptance and migration outputs were revalidated.

Future hydrated bytes must produce at least 98 percent same-UPRN joins with zero duplicate conflicts; nearest-point joins remain forbidden.
Required fields, postcode aliases, exact join key, normalization, 98 percent threshold, address-point semantics and no-promotion are covered.
